meta.notes: Launcher tools only. Boot-level Linux entries (Clonezilla, ShredOS, Memtest86+, GParted, ddrescue, chntpw) are GRUB entries, not launcher tools, and live in the boot config. Per tool fields: id, name, description, type (script|builtin|portable), category, path (relative to the stick root), plane (winpe|live|both, where it can run), baked (true = baked into the WinPE core, false = on the data partition), console (optional, true if it needs a console window), license (ours|oss|freeware|trial), status (optional: planned or last-resort), source {url, kind: direct|page|clickthrough}. sha256 is added later for verified fetches.

planes.winpe: runs in the WinPE boot environment
planes.live: runs only on a full running Windows system
planes.both: runs in WinPE and on live Windows
